title: 第8章 终于有车了
novel_title: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
郁凡修炼了一晚上，知道目前只有自己和郁颜在家，想着要不要把车子的事情给解决了。

    他从神识中看到郁颜正对着那个被人称为手机的方块说话，并未在意。

    从房间走出来后，便直接一跃从楼上栏杆上一跃而下。

    “我去！主播！你身后有超人！”

    “我以为是我眼花，原来是真的有！”

    “居然能从这么高的地方跳下来还没有一点事，这不加入国家队对得起国家吗？”

    郁颜不知道粉丝们在说什么，但身后有人这点她还是知道了。

    转过身看到郁凡正站在她身后，郁颜吓了一跳，说实话，她是有点怕这个爷爷的。

    毕竟爷爷的气势真的太强了，感觉在他面前，她都不敢大声讲话。

    “爷爷，您在家啊。”

    郁凡点点头，“你在做什么？”

    郁颜这才想起自己在直播的事情，“哦，这个，我在直播。”

    “直播？”郁凡有些不理解，对于这个小方块上快速闪过的一些字倒是挺有兴趣的。

    “对。”郁颜突然想起自己的爷爷据说一直隐世在深山，似乎对现代社会上的东西并不了解。

    “对了，爷爷，你也买一个手机吧？这样也方便联系。”

    “手机就是这种小方块的千里传讯法器吗？”郁凡疑惑的问。

    郁颜有些想要扶额，爷爷，你在想什么，为什么会觉得这个是法器？

    “哈哈哈，这个人好逗。”

    “等等，为什么主播会喊这个年轻人爷爷啊？”

    “主播不会是被人包了吧？这是和金主之间的爱称吗？”

    “这人手机都没有买，深山来的吗？”

    郁颜跟郁凡解释了一番手机的作用，突然想到自己还在直播，连忙把直播给关了。

    “我要出去买东西，你要去吗？”郁凡问道。
content_en:
Yu Fan practiced all night, knowing that he and Yu Yan were the only ones at home now, and he was thinking about whether to solve the car problem.

From his consciousness, he saw Yu Yan talking to the square called a mobile phone, but didn't pay attention.

After walking out of the room, he jumped directly from the railing upstairs.

"I'm going! Anchor! There's Superman behind you!"

"I thought it was my eyesight, but it turned out it was real!"

"It's okay to jump from such a high place. Isn't it worthy of the country if you don't join the national team?"

Yu Yan didn't know what the fans were talking about, but she still knew that there was someone behind her.

When she turned around and saw Yu Fan standing behind her, Yu Yan was startled. To be honest, she was a little afraid of this grandpa.

After all, grandpa's momentum was so strong that she felt that she didn't dare to speak loudly in front of him.

"Grandpa, you are at home."

Yu Fan nodded, "What are you doing?"

Only then did Yu Yan remember that she was live broadcasting, "Oh, this, I am live broadcasting."

"Live broadcast?" Yu Fan was a little confused, but he was quite interested in some words that flashed quickly on this small square.

"Yes." Yu Yan suddenly remembered that his grandfather was said to have been hiding in the mountains and seemed to have no understanding of things in modern society.

"By the way, grandpa, why don't you also buy a mobile phone? It will also make it easier to contact me."

"Is a mobile phone a small square-shaped instrument that can communicate across thousands of miles?" Yu Fan asked doubtfully.

Yu Yan wanted to hold her forehead. Grandpa, what are you thinking about? Why do you think this is a magic weapon?

"Hahaha, this person is so funny."

"Wait a minute, why did the anchor call this young man grandpa?"

"Isn't the anchor being hired by someone? Is this a nickname between him and his sponsor?"

"This guy didn't even buy a mobile phone. Did he come from the mountains?"

Yu Yan explained the function of the mobile phone to Yu Fan, and suddenly realized that she was still live broadcasting, so she quickly turned off the live broadcast.

"I'm going out to buy something, are you going?" Yu Fan asked.
